backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing production tracking system with user profiles, production records, dispatch records, work-in-hand calculations, and daily production reports, all protected by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, and hooks for the production tracking application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space for the application's design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Shipping Container Manufacturing Production Tracker application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with seven routes (dashboard, production entry/history, dispatch, work-in-hand, daily production report), all wrapped with AuthGuard, Layout, ThemeProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying access restriction message with shield icon and login button for unauthenticated or non-admin users.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that checks login status and admin role, displays loading spinner during initialization, shows ProfileSetupModal for new users, and AccessDeniedScreen for unauthorized access.
frontend/src/components/DailyProductionR: Filter component for daily production reports with date range picker, operation dropdown (from predefined list of 17 operations), and apply/clear buttons to filter report data.

Form component for creating and editing daily production reports with fields for date, operation name, production numbers, and automatic in-hand calculation. Includes validation, toast notifications, and integration with create/update hooks.

Table component displaying daily production reports with sortable columns, edit/delete actions, and confirmation dialogs. Supports sorting by date, operation, and numeric fields with visual sort indicators.
Date range filter component with start/end date inputs, apply/clear buttons, and validation to ensure start date doesn't exceed end date.
frontend/src/components/DispatchEntryFor: Form for recording dispatch entries with fields for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Includes validation and integration with dispatch record creation hook.
frontend/src/components/DispatchRecordsT: Sortable table displaying dispatch records with columns for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Includes empty state handling and sort functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header, navigation (desktop and mobile), authentication-aware routing, and integration with Internet Identity. Includes navigation items for dashboard, production, dispatch, and reports.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states, error handling, and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProductionHistor: Displays a sortable table of production records with columns for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes. Supports sorting by any column with visual indicators and shows empty state when no records exist.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup that prompts for a name and prevents dismissal until completed. Uses the useSaveCallerUserProfile hook to persist the profile.
frontend/src/components/RecentProduction: Displays a simple table showing the most recent production records (default 10) with date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes. Shows empty state when no records exist.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a title, numeric/text value, icon, and optional description with hover effects. Used for dashboard summary statistics.
Displays inventory status table showing produced quantity, dispatched quantity, and current inventory for each container type. Shows empty state when no inventory data is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control with admin token from URL params. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
Mutation hook to add a dispatch record via the actor, invalidating dispatch records and work-in-hand status queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddProductionRecor: Mutation hook to add a production record via the actor, invalidating production records and work-in-hand status queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateDailyProduct: Mutation hook to create a daily production report via the actor, invalidating daily production reports queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteDailyProduct: Mutation hook to delete a daily production report by finding its ID from all reports and calling the delete method, invalidating queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDailyProduct: Query hook to fetch all daily production reports from the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDispatchReco: Query hook to fetch all dispatch records from the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllProductionRe: Query hook to fetch all production records from the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook to fetch the current user's profile from the backend actor, with combined loading state from actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetProductionRecor: Query hook to fetch production records filtered by date range, falling back to all records if no date range is provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetWorkInHandStatu: Query hook to fetch work-in-hand status (inventory) records from the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking. Creates AuthClient with configurable options and handles identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Query hook to check if the current caller has admin privileges via the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for user profiles, production records, dispatch records, and work-in-hand status, including queries and mutations that interact with the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Provides a mutation hook to save the current user's profile and invalidate the user profile query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateDailyProduct: Mutation hook that finds an existing daily production report by date and operation name, then updates it via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom industrial-themed color palette for light and dark modes, plus utility classes for tables, cards, and metrics.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DailyProductionReport: Page for viewing, filtering, and editing daily production reports for 40ft High Cube Shipping Containers with form and table components.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard overview displaying summary metrics (total produced, dispatched, work in hand, container types) and a recent production table.
Page for recording and viewing dispatch records with a form and sortable table of all dispatch entries.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionEntryPage.t: Form page for entering new production records with fields for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage: Page displaying historical production records with date range filtering capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInHandPage.tsx: Page showing current inventory status by container type with summary cards and a detailed work-in-hand table.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography, container queries, animations, and industrial design system tokens for the application UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a responsive industrial production tracking web app for 40ft High Cube Container manufacturing with 17 operations, admin authentication, daily production reporting, dashboard, history, dispatch tracking, and operation-wise status features.
